bio.text: Mike Cronk, a Republican, has represented District R in the Alaska Senate since 2025, after serving in the Alaska House of Representatives from 2021 to 2024, according to the Alaska Legislature.

The legislative biography says Cronk's family moved to Northway, Alaska, in 1978, that Cronk graduated from the University of Alaska Fairbanks in 1992, and that Cronk taught in Northway and Tok for 25 years before retiring in 2017.
Cronk was elected to the Alaska Gateway School District regional school board in November 2018, according to the biography.
